query: What practical methods best correct measurement error in MTL series (errors-in-variables models, IV, alternative MTL metrics, sensitivity bounds) to avoid attenuation bias?

response.query: What practical methods best correct measurement error in MTL series (errors-in-variables models, IV, alternative MTL metrics, sensitivity bounds) to avoid attenuation bias?
response.answer: To correct measurement error in MTL series, use instrumental variables (IV) and errors-in-variables models to mitigate attenuation bias. Sensitivity bounds can also help assess the impact of measurement error.
